mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.seller_id, s.nickname AS seller_nickname, o.buyer_id, b.nickname AS buyer_nickname, o.final_price, o.status, o.payment_due, o.address::text AS address, o.tracking_number, o.chatting_session_id, o.created_at, o.updated_at, a.auction_id, a.start_price, a.current_price, a.status AS auction_status, a.ended_at AS auction_ended_at, p.product_id, p.title AS product_title, p.thumbnail_url, p.condition, p.model_name, pay.payment_id, pay.amount AS payment_amount, pay.type AS payment_type, pay.paid_at, st.settlement_id, st.net_amount, st.payout_at FROM "order" o JOIN auction a ON a.auction_id = o.auction_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = a.product_id JOIN member s ON s.member_id = o.seller_id JOIN member b ON b.member_id = o.buyer_id LEFT JOIN payment pay ON pay.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN settlement st ON st.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT b.member_id FROM auction a JOIN bid b ON b.bid_id = a.top_bid_id WHERE a.auction_id = #{auctionId}

SELECT b.member_id FROM bid b JOIN member m ON m.member_id = b.member_id WHERE b.auction_id = #{auctionId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order" o WHERE o.auction_id = b.auction_id AND o.buyer_id = b.member_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification n WHERE n.auction_id = b.auction_id AND n.member_id = b.member_id AND n.type = 'AUCTION_WON' AND n.title = '차순위 낙찰 안내') ORDER BY b.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT n.auction_id FROM notification n WHERE n.type = 'AUCTION_WON' AND n.title = '차순위 낙찰 안내' AND n.created_at < #{before} AND n.created_at = (SELECT MAX(x.created_at) FROM notification x WHERE x.auction_id = n.auction_id AND x.type = 'AUCTION_WON' AND x.title = '차순위 낙찰 안내') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order" o WHERE o.auction_id = n.auction_id AND o.buyer_id = n.member_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order" o2 WHERE o2.auction_id = n.auction_id AND o2.status <> 'CANCELED')
SELECT o.order_id, o.buyer_id, o.seller_id, o.status, o.carrier, o.tracking_number, o.address::text AS address FROM "order" o WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
